topic: Octopus: has three hearts and blue blood, and can change both colour and skin texture in an instant to hide.

episode.title: Wild Superpowers: The Octopus That Vanishes!

shots.narration: Did you know an octopus can hide before your eyes?
shots.scene: Vertical 9:16, bright 3D animated shallow ocean reef, viewed through a spacious underwater observation dome; Kiko and Pip inside, an octopus outside.
shots.action: The octopus changes from reddish orange to the sandy colour beneath it.
shots.mood: Sunny turquoise water, sparkling light, startling discovery; no text.

shots.narration: Kiko spots an octopus beside a bumpy rock.
shots.scene: Inside the clear observation dome, Kiko's green safari hat and pocketed khaki vest frame a view of the reef.
shots.action: Kiko raises his big binoculars toward the octopus outside.
shots.mood: Bright underwater light, eager curiosity, cute true-to-life animal design; no te

shots.scene: Close view of the octopus beside a pale, knobbly reef rock in clear turquoise water.
shots.action: The octopus instantly matches the rock's colour and bumpy texture.
shots.mood: Playful mystery, natural camouflage, soft sunbeams; no text.

shots.narration: Its hiding trick has Kiko completely puzzled.
shots.scene: Inside the observation dome, the camouflaged octopus remains visible as a subtle outline against the rock outside.
shots.action: Kiko leans close to the glass with wide, searching eyes.
shots.mood: Gentle comic confusion, bright ocean colours; no text.

shots.narration: Pip notices an arm curled against the rock.
shots.scene: Inside the clear dome, emerald-green Pip faces the reef; a curled octopus arm is discernible outside.
shots.action: Pip points one tiny wing toward the curled arm.
shots.mood: Delighted discovery, ruby throat catching sunlight; no text.

shots.narration: [excited] It changes colour and skin texture in an instant!
shots.scene: Close underwater view of the octopus on the same pale, bumpy rock, bright natural 3D nature-film styling.
shots.action: The octopus instantly shifts from pale and bumpy to reddish and smooth.
shots.mood: Wonderful reveal, clear skin detail, sunny ocean glow; no text.

shots.narration: And this amazing animal has three hearts.
shots.scene: Clear dome foreground with Kiko watching the now-visible octopus resting peacefully on the reef outside.
shots.action: Kiko holds up three fingers beside the glass.
shots.mood: Warm amazement, friendly educational discovery; no text.

shots.scene: Sunlit close-up of the healthy reddish octopus on the reef, with its natural outer skin fully intact.
shots.action: The octopus gently uncurls one arm.
shots.mood: Calm wonder, cute but true-to-life details, turquoise water; no text.

shots.narration: [whispers] Guess our next animal: whose superpower lights up the dark?
shots.scene: Inside the observation dome overlooking a shaded reef crevice; the octopus rests on its rock outside.
shots.action: Kiko points toward the mysterious dark crevice.
shots.mood: Inviting mystery, gentle blue shadows, warm sunlit foreground; no text.

episode.endHook: Guess our next animal: whose superpower lights up the dark?
episode.description: Kiko and Pip discover an octopus hiding in plain sight! Explore its instant colour and skin-texture changes, three hearts, and blue blood.
